generic_name: azelastine hydrochloride / fluticasone propionate nasal spray
revenue_scope: Worldwide consolidated net sales of the Dymista brand
moa: Histamine H1-receptor antagonist (azelastine) plus corticosteroid (fluticasone propionate) fixed-dose nasal combination

approval_evidence.quote: DYMISTA AZELASTINE HYDROCHLORIDE; FLUTICASONE PROPIONATE 0.137MG/SPRAY;0.05MG/SPRAY SPRAY, METERED;NASAL ... 05/01/2012 ORIG-1 Approval

launch_evidence.quote: We began the US launch of Dymista in September. ... Meda launched Dymista late in the quarter, which resulted in sales at the wholesale level of SEK 31 million.

series_start_reason: 2012Q3 is the first quarter Dymista has sales: Meda AB (the marketer, acquired by Mylan N.V. in August 2016) began the US launch in September 2012 and printed SEK 31 million for the quarter in its January-September 2012 interim report. The January-September 2013 report prints the January-September 2012 comparative as 31, so no earlier quarter has sales. The series joins two issuers on one scope, the worldwide net sales of the Dymista brand: Meda AB 2012Q3-2016Q2 in SEK from the 'Sales trends for the 20 best-selling products' table (or the report text for the two launch quarters), and Viatris 2021Q1-2026Q2 in USD from the 'Key Product Net Sales, on a Consolidated Basis' table. Neither issuer printed a Dymista figure for 2016Q3-2020Q4 (see unreported_quarters).
series_end_reason: Latest quarter published at the time of sourcing (Viatris 2Q26 earnings release, 8-K filed 2026-08-06); Dymista remains in the key-product table.
notes: Scope is the 'Key Product Net Sales, on a Consolidated Basis' table (Select Key Segment Products): consolidated net sales of the Dymista brand across all Viatris geographies; the table does not split U.S. from ex-U.S. Viatris retained Dymista when it divested its OTC business to Cooper Consumer Health on 2024-07-03 (10-K FY2025 note: rights for Viagra and Dymista retained, 'in certain limited markets, are sold as OTC products'), so the table scope did not change at that divestiture. Each quarter is read from that quarter's own earnings release (current-period column). Annual cross-check: quarters sum to the printed full year in the 4Q releases for 2022-2025 (2022: 179.9 vs printed 179.8, rounding) and for 2021 the 4Q21 release prints 168.0 (40.3+54.6+35.0+38.1). Meda AB history (2012Q3-2016Q2, SEK): every quarter is read from the Meda interim or year-end report for that quarter, except 2013Q2 and 2014Q2, whose January-June reports (published 2013-08-02 and 2014-08-13) could not be located: each is the nine-month figure of the following January-September report less the first and third quarters (2013: 286 less 63 less 109 = 114; 2014: 497 less 156 less 152 = 189; the 2014 figure also appears as the April-June 2014 column of the January-June 2015 report). 2012Q3 and 2012Q4 are text figures (the 2012 product-trend tables do not list Dymista): 31 is wholesale-level sales in the launch month and 33 is the fourth-quarter text figure, both US only because the European approval came in 2013. 2013Q1 is the table row 'Dymista 63' with a dash for the 2012 comparison. Annual cross-checks against the year-end tables: 2012 31+33=64, 2013 63+114+109+163=449, 2014 156+189+152+224=721, 2015 193+281+223+306=1,003 (SEK). Meda's pre-2015 tables stand on Meda's own presentation (reports published on mb.cision.com, the news-wire host of Meda's reports; the issuer's meda.se site is no longer served). Meda's text also gives US-only Dymista sentences (for example SEK 148 million for 2015Q1); the series keeps the group-total table row. The SEK-to-USD step at 2021Q1 is for the gold builder's currency normalization; no row is converted here.
search_log: Listed Viatris (CIK 0001792044) filings via data.sec.gov/submissions (all forms, recent list of 541); downloaded every 10-Q, 10-K and 8-K Exhibit 99.1 earnings release 2020-2026 (including 3Q21 release, an 8-K carrying only item 9.01) and searched the converted text for the brand name; table rows were parsed for lines beginning with the brand.
Listed Mylan N.V. (CIK 0001623613) filings 2016-2020 and downloaded every 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q and 8-K Exhibit 99 earnings release; searched for the brand name.

Row 'Dymista ®' parsed from the 'Key Product Net Sales, on a Consolidated Basis' table of each Viatris earnings release Exhibit 99.1 for 1Q21-2Q26 (22 releases, including the 3Q21 release, an 8-K with only item 9.01); the first figure on each line is the current quarter. The same figures appear in the matching 10-Qs (and 10-K full years 168.0, 179.8, 200.0, 188.0, 163.6).

Absence before 2021Q1: Viatris 8-K filed 2021-02-22 (Exhibits 99.1/99.2), FY2020 10-K and 10-K/A, Mylan N.V. 10-Qs/10-Ks/earnings releases 2016-2020 searched for 'Dymista': prose mentions only (10-K FY2016-FY2019 describe the product), no sales figure.

Meda AB history located via web search (Year-end Report 2015 and Interim Report Jan-Jun 2015 PDFs on mb.cision.com print Dymista in SEK); not sourced further because it cannot be joined without a 2016Q3-2020Q4 gap and is in SEK.

Re-check of the 2021Q1 start: the converted text of the Viatris 8-K filed 2021-02-22 (Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, the 4Q20 release), the FY2020 10-K, the 2020 10-Qs and the 2020 8-K releases contains no Dymista row or figure; the 1Q21 release prints Dymista as a single current-quarter figure (40.3) with no prior-year column, and the 2Q21 and 3Q21 releases print no 2020 comparatives, so no 2020 quarter is printed anywhere. Row labels in the tables read 'Dymista ®'; the first printed prior-year column is in the 1Q22 release (2021 quarter).

Extension pass: Meda AB reports located by web search of mb.cision.com (Meda's wire host) and read with pdfplumber: interim reports January-September 2012, January-March 2013, January-September 2013, January-March 2014, January-September 2014, January-March 2015, January-June 2015, January-September 2015, January-March 2016, January-June 2016 and year-end reports for 2012-2015. Dymista row parsed from the 'Sales trends for the 20 best-selling products' table; prose figures for 2012Q3 and 2012Q4.

Not located despite searches: Meda's interim reports January-June 2013 and January-June 2014 (no PDF found on mb.cision.com, globenewswire or firstwordpharma); the two second quarters are derived from the nine-month tables as stated in notes.

Before 2012Q3: the January-September 2013 table row prints 31 as the January-September 2012 comparative, equal to the 2012Q3 figure, so 2012Q1 and 2012Q2 had no sales; the January-September 2012 report calls the late-September 2012 launch the start of US sales. The January-June 2012 report (globenewswire copy, answered 403 to download) was seen only as a search excerpt that speaks of the US pre-launch.

After 2016Q2: Meda was acquired (Mylan 8-K filed 2016-08-11, Item 2.01) and delisted 2016-08-23, so its next scheduled report (January-September 2016, announced for 2016-10-26) was not found. Mylan N.V. Forms 10-K FY2016-FY2019 and 10-K/As and Viatris FY2020 10-K and 10-K/A re-read for the name 'Dymista': one or two occurrences of the name per Mylan 10-K, none next to a dollar, SEK or net-sales wording; no mentions in the Viatris FY2020 10-K.
